panels.title: Adoption by built-in or verified extension feature ID

targets.rawSql: SELECT Dimension1 AS feature_id, multiIf(Dimension1='generic', 'generic', Dimension1='overflow', 'overflow', startsWith(Dimension1, 'builtin/'), 'built-in', startsWith(Dimension1, 'extension/'), 'verified extension', 'invalid') AS feature_class, sum(Value) AS observed_installations FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'feature_adoption' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY feature_id ORDER BY observed_installations DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Built-in / verified extension / generic / overflow ratio

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(Dimension1='generic', 'generic', Dimension1='overflow', 'overflow', startsWith(Dimension1, 'builtin/'), 'built-in', startsWith(Dimension1, 'extension/'), 'verified extension', 'invalid') AS feature_class, sum(Value) AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'feature_adoption' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) GROUP BY feature_class

options.content: Built-in IDs use `builtin/<kind>/<key>` from the exact-type catalog. Extension IDs use `extension/<canonical-marketplace-package-id>/<kind>/<key>` only when a Marketplace-approved analytics manifest and package digest match; sideloaded, legacy, and invalid values remain `generic`, while capped summaries use `overflow`.
